entries.rationale: Ollama inference adapter routes through providerFetch. Active formal budget scope receives the original request without an adapter dispatcher override; host-owned scoped transport and closed-scope refusal remain authoritative. Outside scope, explicit dispatchers and injected/global fetch are preserved, and the default undici Agent disables keep-alive without adding replay. Configurable Ollama destinations are not restricted to loopback by this classification; paid or OS admission is not granted.

Provider streaming adapters retain scoped providerFetch routing and verified EOF. Ollama now delegates its chat/generate POST to ollamaProviderFetch, which preserves active formal budget authority and disables default idle-connection reuse only outside scope. Other provider requests and usage/completion handling are unchanged; classification does not attest paid runtime coverage.

Canonical provider/tool execution host retains scoped model egress. Ollama nonstreaming and streaming POSTs now use ollamaProviderFetch, preserving host-owned formal budget transport and closed-scope refusal while changing only default unscoped connection reuse. Existing caller retry, tool gating, usage settlement and oversized-result identity boundaries are not expanded by this adapter. This source classification does not grant financial or OS admission.
